nodes.label: gold.audit_log
nodes.code:
-- audit_log is a fact table (nothing points at it, 1 reference(s) out, measures 0.5); one row per audit_log row with 1 table(s) joined in over the safest many-to-one paths.
-- join audit_log.customer_id -> customers.customer_id: rule R1
CREATE OR REPLACE MATERIALIZED LAKE VIEW `gold`.`audit_log`
(
    -- audit_log.customer_id points at customers.customer_id (rule R1: column named `<B>_id` / `<B>id` / `<singular B>_id` / `<singular B>id` (also _key, _code, _nr, _no, _sk, _bk) where B has a single key); a row whose reference finds no customers is dropped, a NULL reference is kept (it says unknown, not wrong)
    CONSTRAINT audit_log_customer_id_in_customers CHECK ((`customer_id` IS NULL) OR (`customers_customer_id` IS NOT NULL)) ON MISMATCH DROP
)
COMMENT "Krusgraph gold view of audit_log from silver, generated from the plan; rules in the constraint comments"
TBLPROPERTIES ("krusgraph.gold"="00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001/shop")
AS
SELECT
    f.`event` AS `event`,
    f.`customer_id` AS `customer_id`,
    f.`happened_at` AS `happened_at`,
    d1.`customer_id` AS `customers_customer_id`,
    d1.`country` AS `customers_country`
FROM `silver`.`audit_log` AS f
    LEFT JOIN `silver`.`customers` AS d1 ON f.`customer_id` = d1.`customer_id`

nodes.code:
-- order_items is a fact table (nothing points at it, 2 reference(s) out, measures 1.0); one row per order_items row with 4 table(s) joined in over the safest many-to-one paths.
-- join order_items.order_id -> orders.order_id: rule R1
-- join order_items.product_id -> products.product_id: rule R1
-- join products.category_id -> categories.id: rule R1
-- join orders.customer_id -> customers.customer_id: rule R1
CREATE OR REPLACE MATERIALIZED LAKE VIEW `gold`.`order_items`
(
    -- the key of order_items is order_id + line_no (rule K5: line: no column names a key); a row without it identifies nothing
    CONSTRAINT order_items_key_present CHECK (`order_id` IS NOT NULL AND `line_no` IS NOT NULL) ON MISMATCH DROP,
    -- order_items.order_id points at orders.order_id (rule R1: column named `<B>_id` / `<B>id` / `<singular B>_id` / `<singular B>id` (also _key, _code, _nr, _no, _sk, _bk) where B has a single key); a row whose reference finds no orders is dropped, a NULL reference is kept (it says unknown, not wrong)
    CONSTRAINT order_items_order_id_in_orders CHECK ((`order_id` IS NULL) OR (`orders_order_id` IS NOT NULL)) ON MISMATCH DROP,
    -- order_items.product_id points at products.product_id (rule R1: column named `<B>_id` / `<B>id` / `<singular B>_id` / `<singular B>id` (also _key, _code, _nr, _no, _sk, _bk) where B has a single key); a row whose reference finds no products is dropped, a NULL reference is kept (it says unknown, not wrong)
    CONSTRAINT order_items_product_id_in_products CHECK ((`product_id` IS NULL) OR (`products_product_id` IS NOT NULL)) ON MISMATCH DROP,
    -- products.category_id points at categories.id (rule R1: column named `<B>_id` / `<B>id` / `<singular B>_id` / `<singular B>id` (also _key, _code, _nr, _no, _sk, _bk) where B has a single key); a row whose reference finds no categories is dropped, a NULL reference is kept (it says unknown, not wrong)
    CONSTRAINT order_items_products_category_id_in_categories CHECK ((`products_category_id` IS NULL) OR (`categories_id` IS NOT NULL)) ON MISMATCH DROP,
    -- orders.customer_id points at customers.customer_id (rule R1: column named `<B>_id` / `<B>id` / `<singular B>_id` / `<singular B>id` (also _key, _code, _nr, _no, _sk, _bk) where B has a single key); a row whose reference finds no customers is dropped, a NULL reference is kept (it says unknown, not wrong)
    CONSTRAINT order_items_orders_customer_id_in_customers CHECK ((`orders_customer_id` IS NULL) OR (`customers_customer_id` IS NOT NULL)) ON MISMATCH DROP
)
COMMENT "Krusgraph gold view of order_items from silver, generated from the plan; rules in the constraint comments"
TBLPROPERTIES ("krusgraph.gold"="00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001/shop")
AS
SELECT
    f.`order_id` AS `order_id`,
    f.`line_no` AS `line_no`,
    f.`product_id` AS `product_id`,
    f.`quantity` AS `quantity`,
    d1.`order_id` AS `orders_order_id`,
    d1.`customer_id` AS `orders_customer_id`,
    d1.`order_date` AS `orders_order_date`,
    d1.`ship_to_id` AS `orders_ship_to_id`,
    d2.`product_id` AS `products_product_id`,
    d2.`name` AS `products_name`,
    d2.`category_id` AS `products_category_id`,
    d3.`id` AS `categories_id`,
    d3.`name` AS `categories_name`,
    d4.`customer_id` AS `customers_customer_id`,
    d4.`country` AS `customers_country`
FROM `silver`.`order_items` AS f
    LEFT JOIN `silver`.`orders` AS d1 ON f.`order_id` = d1.`order_id`
    LEFT JOIN `silver`.`products` AS d2 ON f.`product_id` = d2.`product_id`
    LEFT JOIN `silver`.`categories` AS d3 ON d2.`category_id` = d3.`id`
    LEFT JOIN `silver`.`customers` AS d4 ON d1.`customer_id` = d4.`customer_id`
